posts.hook: Huang is out. Now Washington wants answers from him and from the Commerce Secretary
posts.caption: the senate banking chair wants jensen huang and howard lutnick to testify in december, an analysis claims six chinese open models carry fingerprints of export-controlled nvidia chips, and google made gemini 4 hydrogen the default in search's ai mode. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: The Senate asks Jensen Huang and Howard Lutnick to testify in December
slides.desc: Lutnick agreed. The inquiry is widening from one CEO to how chip export policy was made.

slides.title: Analysis claims six Chinese open models carry fingerprints of banned Blackwell chips
slides.desc: One group's forensic reading of public model files, ==not yet independently confirmed==.

terms.gloss: nvidia's current ai chips, barred from sale to china

slides.title: Google makes Gemini 4 Hydrogen the default model in Search's AI Mode
slides.desc: Also the new free tier, yet ==15 times== the price of rivals' small models on the API.

slides.title: Mirendil raises a $1B Series A to build self-improving AI
slides.desc: Founded by former Anthropic researchers, six months after a $200M seed.

slides.title: US moves to seize $1.2B of the crypto frozen after the Binance hack
slides.desc: Stablecoin issuers froze $2.7B of the $6.3B stolen. That freeze is the recovery route.

terms.gloss: a crypto token pegged to the dollar, run by a company

slides.title: The FAA takes its AI rerouting advice nationwide after 180 flights
slides.desc: Airlines back it. The controllers' union says it was not involved in design or testing.

terms.gloss: the us agency that runs air traffic control

posts.hook: Outlook went dark for almost two days, and Microsoft says a health check is to blame
posts.caption: microsoft 365's global outage ran almost two days before email began returning, nvidia's board has reportedly approached arm's ceo about succeeding jensen huang, and openai gave its agents a wallet. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: Microsoft 365's global outage ran ==almost two days== before email started coming back
slides.desc: Microsoft blames failed server health checks, not an attack. Mail delivery is still delayed.

slides.title: Nvidia's board has approached Arm CEO Rene Haas about succeeding Jensen Huang, sources say
slides.desc: Haas worked at Nvidia over a decade ago. The interim chief had questioned Huang's deals.

terms.gloss: the uk company whose chip designs run nearly every phone

slides.title: Nscale's IPO filing: debt went from $137M to $5.5B in three months
slides.desc: It says it needs more funding after ordering Nvidia chips for a $45B Anthropic contract.

terms.gloss: an nvidia-backed company that rents out ai data centers

slides.title: OpenAI gives its agents a wallet: ChatGPT can now complete purchases
slides.desc: With the user's approval and existing card protections. US Pro subscribers over 18 first.

slides.title: Google's Project Zero will cut its bug disclosure deadline from 90 days to ==30 days== by 2028
slides.desc: Its reasoning: AI lets attackers find the same bugs faster and turn a patch into an exploit.

terms.gloss: google's team that hunts security bugs in everyone's software

slides.title: Fake risk warnings make AI agents refuse legitimate work, a paper finds
slides.desc: Telling the agent to be careful made it worse: wrongful refusals went from 9.8% to 86.3%.
